[db=live]Welcome to the Protection Paladin rotation guide for Midnight Season 2! This guide will teach you all about the optimal rotation for Protection Paladin across its various talent builds. It will cover both core ability cadence and cooldown usage in dungeons and raids for [b]Midnight Season 2[/b].
[pad]

sections.heading: How to Play Protection
sections.body:
[h2 type=bar toc="How to Play Protection"][color=c2]Protection Paladin Rotation in Midnight Season 2[/color][/h2]
The rotation for Protection Paladin is very simple. Build Holy Power, Spend Holy Power. We really don't have that many buttons so as long as you are pressing the few you have consistently you can perform fantastically.


[wrapper width=1100px][box border=true]
[center][table style=grid]
[tr][td]
[table]
	[tr]
	[td width=6%][icon name=spell_holy_righteousfury size=medium type=round color=c2 inline=true][/icon][/td]
	[td][b][color=c2]Generate and Spend Resources:[/color][/b] Using [spell=275779] and [spell=204019] to steadily build Holy Power to then use on [spell=53600] and [spell=85673] is integral to Protection Paladin.
	[/td][/tr]
[/table]
[hr]
[table]
	[tr]
	[td width=6%][icon name=spell_holy_ardentdefender size=medium type=round color=c2 inline=true][/icon][/td]
	[td][b][color=c2]Never overcap Holy Power:[/color][/b] You should never sit on Holy Power cap, make sure you are constantly spending it. 
	[/td][/tr]
[/table]
[hr]
[table]
	[tr]
	[td width=6%][icon name=ability_paladin_shieldofvengeance size=medium type=round color=c2 inline=true][/icon][/td]
	[td][b][color=c2]Plan your Defensives:[/color][/b] Protection Paladin can often feel quite squishy if you aren't cycling your defensive cooldowns actively during high damage intake periods.[/td]
	[/tr]
[/table]
[/td][/tr][/table]
[/center]
[/box][/wrapper]
[pad]
[center][cta-button guide=32914 icon=ability_paladin_shieldofthetemplar]Protection Paladin Starter Guide[/cta-button][/center]

sections.heading: Major Cooldowns
sections.body:
[h2 toc="Major Cooldowns" type=bar][color=c2][icon name=ability_paladin_shieldofthetemplar type=round size=medium inline=true color=c2][/icon] Protection Paladin Major Cooldowns[/color][/h2]
[spell=31884] is an enjoyable and commonly active cooldown. It changes our [spell=20271] into [spell=1241288] and increases our damage/healing and crit chance.

[pad]

[tabs name="cds" uniform=true iconborders=true]

[tab name="Avenging Wrath" icon=spell_holy_avenginewrath]
	[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c2] Avenging Wrath [/color][/h3]
[spell=31884] is an enjoyable and commonly active cooldown. It changes our [spell=20271] into [spell=1241288] and increases our damage/healing and crit chance.
[/tab]

[tab name="Ardent Defender" icon=spell_holy_ardentdefender]
	[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c2] Avenging Wrath [/color][/h3]
An extremely short cooldown that should be used as frequently as possible to smooth overall damage intake. Rarely, it can be held for a short time to align with bigger damage spikes.
[/tab]

[tab name="Guardian of Ancient Kings" icon=spell_holy_heroism]
	[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c2] Avenging Wrath [/color][/h3]
A 50% damage reduction on a fairly long cooldown, this is our biggest damage reduction cooldown and should be reserved for dangerous periods during a pull or encounter.
[/tab]

[tab name="Divine Shield" icon=spell_holy_divineshield]
	[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c2] Avenging Wrath [/color][/h3]
Get out of jail free card. Immunity to damage and most debuffs for a short duration.
[/tab]

[/tabs]

sections.heading: Advanced Tips
sections.body:
[h2 toc="Advanced Tips" type=bar][color=c2][icon name=Inv_artifact_tome01 type=round size=medium inline=true color=c2][/icon] Protection Paladin Advanced Tips[/color][/h2]
[pad]


[tabs name="advanced" uniform=true iconborders=true]
[tab name="Always Be Casting" icon=spell_holy_righteousfury]
	[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c1] Always Be Casting [/color][/h3]
	This is a classic staple for all specs in WoW, ABC. Always be casting. Your gcd usage is extremely important, if you are missing 10-20% of your total casts just because you aren't mashing fast enough then you are going to be losing a significant amount of damage and holy power generation. This all plays into itself, less resources, less cdr, less damage when you need it.
	Your casts don't have to be perfect all the time, just make sure you are actually hitting something instead of mashing buttons that aren't ready yet.
[/tab]
[/tabs]
[pad]

Our Protection Paladin guides are always updated with the latest information from in-game experience, simulations, and logs. Make sure to check our changelog for this page by clicking on [b]View Changelog[/b] in the Quick Facts column or on the book icon at the top of the page.
